name: Umbrage Prism Atoll
core_rationale: Southern eclipse-shadow crystal atoll of Continent 03 where Vesper's smoky quartz spires split twilight starlight into seven walkable spectrum bridges.
local_conflict: Umbral prism-seraphs and shadow-refraction wisps patrol the crystal spectrum spans.

portal_edges.lock_reason: Standing indigo caustic beams across Indigo Caustic Arch require the Umbral Diffraction Grating from Shadow Refraction Crypt.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Optics weavers say the northern Indigo Caustic Arch bends twilight into a standing curtain of violet aurora.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Smoky quartz prism-spires rising from a floating basalt ring and projecting seven-colored light bridges across the void.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What sleeping eclipse-spire lies beyond Indigo Caustic Arch?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-vesper-dream-eater and scar-vesper-crater along the southern eclipse-shadow rim of Continent 03 and connects west to Libration Balance Haven.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Smoky quartz prism-spires splitting twilight starlight into seven walkable spectrum bridges.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Specifies 12.5m crystal spectrum bridges, 0.58m optics tables, and 0.14m quartz risers for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: 2x2 connected matrix at [0,1], [1,1], [1,1] floor -1, and [1,0] with celestial and spirit monster families.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Preserves hunting-area-indigo-caustic-arch as a Mystery frontier behind a Fog of Lore portal with explicit lock_reason.
